Psalms of the Brethren CCXI: Tekicchakari
CXLVIII. TEKEL; or The Sinner weighed in GOD's Balances, and found wanting.
Sonet 6: Je od veselga časa teklo leto
Да, наша жизнь текла мятежно (Da, nasha zhizn tekla myatezhno)
寒山落木 巻一 187: 鐵橋や (Tekkyō ya)
一握の砂 362: 敵として憎みし友と (Teki to shite nikumishi tomo to)
一握の砂 377: 寂莫を敵とし友とし (Sekibaku o teki to shi tomo to shi)
